title: Dot product, checked
statement_md:
Write `dot(a, b)` returning the dot product of two 1-D sequences.

- raise `ValueError` when the lengths differ
- return `0.0` for empty inputs
- do not mutate the inputs

No NumPy needed; loops are fine.
